# namespace_vault_secret_metadata (Data Source)

Reads metadata (version, creation timestamp, labels) for a Namespace Vault secret without exposing its value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    namespace = {
      source = "bsuv/namespace"
    }
  }
}

data "namespace_vault_secret_metadata" "api_key" {
  object_id = "database_connection_key"
}

output "secret_version" {
  description = "Secret version without disclosing secret value"
  value       = data.namespace_vault_secret_metadata.api_key.version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `object_id` (String) Unique object identifier of the Vault secret to inspect.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 creation timestamp.
- `deleted_at` (String) RFC3339 deletion timestamp, if the secret has been soft-deleted.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the secret object.
- `id` (String) Identifier for the secret metadata in Terraform state, matching `object_id`.
- `labels` (Map of String) Immutable key-value labels attached to the secret object.
- `version` (String) Opaque version identifier for optimistic concurrency.
